source_record.inference: The explicit contribution is material at its stated guard even when final action is confirmed rather than changed. Corresponding mechanisms may overlap; duplicate names, reused tests and common pipelines do not create additional benefit or independence.
attempted_contrary_interfaces: Identical test behavior treated as unique artifact identity.
A green pipeline treated as exposure authority.
An approved model treated as actual deployed state.
The same test counted as independent evidence twice.
All evidence discarded after harmless change.
All evidence carried after a changed critical premise.
A trace link treated as proof of the linked claim.

positive_controls.argument: Current release rationale, operating constraints and recovery information let an authorized recipient interpret the candidate and its outstanding conditions.
Recoverable candidate identity and promotion status ensure the technical evidence and authorization refer to the same intended release.
Reconciliation identifies drift and environmental differences that invalidate a claimed release-ready state or require restricted exposure.
Impact and authority analysis identify which readiness or exposure conditions the changed candidate must satisfy and which prior evidence survives.
Supported version contracts and peer ownership define compatibility conditions for the candidate and constrain the permitted exposure sequence.
The method, article, environment and acceptance condition specify what evidence must support the readiness claim.
Evidence at the actual failure level qualifies the behavioral portion of readiness and exposes missing integration coverage.
Accurate links expose unsupported changed claims and identify justified reuse of unaffected evidence in the readiness decision.
The scoped argument and current defeaters identify assurance conditions that limit or defeat the candidate readiness/exposure claim.
The exact anomaly, affected candidate and authorized residual disposition make unresolved limitations visible in readiness and exposure decisions.
Governed authority and version relationships identify which model, package and environment information may support readiness.
Fresh configuration-linked outputs make readiness conditions visible over change and permit reuse of unaffected evidence.
